usage: Used as a noun for the sport/activity of swimming.
Very common in everyday spoken Cantonese; you can say 去游水 to mean going swimming.
Often appears with places and routines, such as pools, beaches, lessons, or exercise habits.
For learners, this is the natural everyday word; in more formal writing, 泳術 or 游泳 may appear instead.

examples.sentence: 我今個星期日想去游水。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 soeng2 heoi3 jau4 seoi2.
examples.meaning: I want to go swimming this Sunday.
